description: Redesign Profile.tsx to X/Twitter style, redesign SideMenu.tsx to X-style drawer, and redesign the VerificationSheet as a verified badge popup bottom sheet with Parallax branding.
steps: Rewrite src/pages/Profile.tsx to match X/Twitter profile style: full-width cover banner (~180px height), large circular avatar (80px) overlapping banner bottom edge, action buttons (... more, message icon, 'Follow' pill or 'Edit profile' if own), bold display name + blue verified badge + @username, bio text, location/link/joined info row with icons, '143 Following  149 Followers' with bold numbers, tabs: Posts | Replies | Media | Likes. Keep all existing data fetching, mutations (follow/block/mute), and state logic intact.

Rewrite src/components/layout/SideMenu.tsx to X-style drawer: large avatar top-left + settings gear icon top-right, display name bold + @username gray + '12 Following  0 Followers', menu items with icons (Profile, Premium with colored '50% off' badge, Communities, Bookmarks, Lists, Spaces, Creator Studio), separator, secondary items (Settings and privacy, Help Center), dark mode toggle at bottom-left. Keep existing Sheet component wrapping, existing auth context usage, and signOut functionality.

Rewrite src/components/profile/VerificationSheet.tsx as a bottom sheet popup matching the design spec: 'Verified account' bold title, blue checkmark icon + 'This account is verified. Learn more' (Learn more in blue), calendar icon + 'Verified since April 2025.' Keep the Sheet component wrapper and existing props interface. Update branding from 'Aurelix' to 'Parallax'.
All components must keep pure black background, white text, minimal spacing. Use existing lucide-react icons, framer-motion for animations, cn() for conditional classes.
acceptance_criteria: Profile page shows X/Twitter style: cover banner, overlapping avatar, action buttons, name/username/bio, metadata row, follow counts, tabbed content
SideMenu drawer shows: avatar, name, follow counts, menu items with icons and badges, secondary items, dark mode toggle
VerificationSheet shows: 'Verified account' title, blue checkmark with description, 'Verified since' date
All existing functionality (follow, block, mute, DM, share, signOut) is preserved
TypeScript compiles without errors (NODE_OPTIONS= npx tsc --noEmit)
verification: NODE_OPTIONS= npx tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors
